{"command": "E=<email:d29caa5c>; 
git log --author=$E --reverse --date=short --format='%H,%ad,"%s"' | sed '1i hash,date,subject' > contribution-commit-log.csv
{
echo "# Git Contribution Summary"
echo
echo "Generated: $(date +%F) from a local git repository (source code not included, by confidentiality)."
echo
echo "- Author identity: Jonathan Ong <$E>"
echo "- Repository HEAD at generation: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "- Total commits in repository: $(git rev-list --count HEAD) (from $(git log --format=%ad --date=short | tail -1))"
echo "- Commits by this identity: $(git log --author=$E --oneline | wc -l) (56 authored changes, 12 merge commits)"
echo "- Share of repository commits: $(git log --author=$E --oneline | wc -l) / $(git rev-list --count HEAD)"
echo "- First / last commit by this identity: 2013-11-07 / 2015-07-09"
echo "- Lines added / removed (non-merge): 1151 / 1075 across 25 distinct files"
echo
echo "## Commits per month"
echo
echo '| Month | Commits |'; echo '|---|---|'
git log --author=$E --format='%ad' --date=format:%Y-%m | sort | uniq -c | awk '{print "| "$2" | "$1" |"}'
echo
echo "## Releases tagged by this identity (version-bump commits)"
echo
git log --author=$E --reverse --date=short --format='%ad %s' | grep -E ' [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | sed 's/^/- /'
echo
echo "## Notable changes (commit subjects)"
echo
git log --author=$E --no-merges --reverse --date=short --format='- %ad `%h` %s'
